risk_note: RV2 by path (payment, ledger, payout, union modules). Fixes the suite hang behind spec/payment/recon-schedule/bootstrap.int.test.ts: kysely 0.29.6 destroy() clears #pool before pool.end(), so a connection mid-handshake reads this.#pool.Client, throws and is never released, and pool.end() waits forever. The trigger was five worker ticks started with void tick() whose stop only cleared timers. Each stop now waits for the in-flight tick and no new tick starts afterwards, matching catalog and settlement; union's tick gets the missing catch. Production close bypasses Kysely.destroy, so this was a shutdown gap there, not a hang. Ticks only read and send singleton jobs, and ledger inserts a unique-keyed claim, so finishing one during shutdown writes no entry or balance. No frozen test changed and no timeout added.
